method: Executed differential (evidence tier 1) for every IDFilter member added in wave 4: ../oracle/B8b-idfilter/driver.cpp compiled with libOpenMS's Release flags against the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 and run twice on ibminode06, each case in a fresh process, both runs byte-identical; a second build and run of the extended driver reproduced every earlier line. The earlier members keep their tier-3 evidence (transcribed IDFilter_test.cpp values in tests/id_filter.rs).

Read for hasValidLimits and the position constants.
